Package com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces

Class VideoNamespace

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.rest.namespaces.VideoNamespace
public class VideoNamespace extends Object
REST namespace for the Video API: rooms, room sessions/recordings, conferences, conference tokens, and individual streams.

Mirrors signalwire.rest.namespaces.video.VideoNamespace. The stream sub-resources hang off rooms and conferences; the top-level streams resource exists for CRUD on individual streams keyed by stream id.
